messages:
Claire (CSM): FYI eng confirmed a short ingestion routing regression between 05:22-05:44 PT impacting a small onboarding cohort. Need coordinated status note, credits for paid POCs, and reschedule support.
Devon (CS Ops): Which accounts and who is renewal-risk? I can prepare trial vs paid templates.
Arjun (Eng): Root cause: a gating flag was omitted during a rollout, causing ~30% of ingest traffic to hit a legacy worker with a requeue bug. Rolled back at 05:44 PT; manual requeues started at 05:48. Queues drained by ~06:05. No data exposure.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-356 logged: ingest-routing-regression. Severity: P2.
Riley (Onboarding): I have two enablement sessions today; let me know which to reschedule.
Claire (CSM): Affected: Skyshop, LegalEase (paid POC), NoteWave, DocuBench, HarborAI, LoopForms (trial); prioritize LegalEase and Skyshop.
Devon (CS Ops): Draft status note: 
Devon (CS Ops): "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We experienced a brief disruption in the embeddings ingestion pipeline between 05:22-05:44 PT today which delayed some onboarding imports. Our team rolled back the change and requeued affected jobs; most work is complete and the remaining items are finishing now.

No customer data was exposed. We will follow up with an RCA and account-specific remediation offers. Your CSM will reach out if any session needs to be rescheduled.

- Redwood Customer Success"

Marta (Billing): Provisional credits for paid POCs approved up to $1,500 pending CSM impact notes.
Arjun (Eng): Postmortem draft in 48 hours; fixes: add rollout gating, pre-rollout ingest smoke, and stronger requeue alerting.
Riley (Onboarding): I'll call Skyshop and DocuBench now and offer a make-good slot. Claire can handle LegalEase.
Claire (CSM): Owners: Claire -> LegalEase, Skyshop; Riley -> NoteWave, DocuBench, HarborAI; Devon -> outbound messages + ticket refs; Marta -> billing credits; Arjun -> eng postmortem.
Incident Bot: Requeue validation: 7/7 jobs completed at 06:07 PT. Incident status: mitigated.
Devon (CS Ops): Sent status email to all impacted with ticket refs. CSMs, please paste replies here. :email:
Claire (CSM): Thanks team. Capturing any customer feedback in the onboarding tracker and marking LegalEase as renewal-watch.
Riley (Onboarding): Added "post-incident check" to each onboarding ticket and will collect UX/error feedback during calls.
Claire (CSM): I'll follow up after the 48h postmortem and after credits are applied. If LegalEase requests an exec sync, tag me immediately.
